Firefox 192kHz Audio Pipeline Build Success Documentation of the successful compilation of Firefox with the 192kHz audio pipeline unlock for the ALC269 codec via PipeWire. Audio DSP
<tag>Firefox</tag> <tag>PipeWire</tag> <tag>AudioStream</tag> <tag>192kHz</tag> <tag>ALC269</tag> <tag>Build</tag>
<lessons_learned> <lesson>Incremental build of Firefox completed successfully in ~21 minutes after modifying CubebUtils.cpp to set sPreferredSampleRate to 192000.</lesson> <lesson>The compiler issued harmless warnings about unreachable code in gfxPlatform.cpp and deprecated mallinfo in nsMemoryReporterManager.cpp.</lesson> <lesson>The ALC269 hardware native playback of up to 192kHz/24-bit is unlocked with zero resampling across the pipeline.</lesson> <lesson>PipeWire is configured with default.clock.quantum = 4096 and min-quantum = 256 to ensure stability at 192kHz.</lesson> </lessons_learned>
[AUDIT VERDICT 2026-08-02 — HISTORICAL-TRUE (G1 experiment)] the 192 kHz unlock built and ran once; superseded by the deliberate 48000 Hz pin under media.gorilla.hardware_only_mode. Do not re-apply sPreferredSampleRate=192000.
